examples.title: ANTES B+ Clinical Trial

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Glycopyrronium Bromide low risk scores for both the liver and the heart [M]. Out of sixteen total clinical studies, several were stopped early for non-medical reasons [3]. For example, studies ended because not enough participants were enrolled, sites were delayed in opening, or investigators left or had scheduled overseas training [4][5][6].
